The claim states that the engine for the McDonnell F3H Demon was renamed to J35 after modifications. Passage [2] clarifies that the Allison J71 was developed from a modified version of the J35 (specifically the J35-A-23). The claim incorrectly characterizes the relationship between the engines and the aircraft's redesign.

Douglas XB-43 Jetmaster | The Douglas XB-43 Jetmaster was an American 1940s jet-powered prototype bomber.
